scope: English aliases for decision/task capture, local unpublished source over f415cf4; no UI or agent protocol edits. No models, OAuth, settings changes or publication.

full.command: systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=1200M -p MemorySwapMax=0 timeout 900 npm test
full.rawPersistence: Temporary local log, not durable published evidence; counts and digest retained here.

accepted: Vietnamese and English capture the same decision and task fields
Ordinary prose does not become a conclusion/task
Markdown and lowercase line markers accepted; inline conclusion still requires uppercase
HTTP work reads and server restart preserve task ID, revision, source message and decision
limits: Agenda/progress markers and outgoing agent protocol remain Vietnamese
Pinned public f415cf4 does not contain aliases
No model quality or net human coordination/cost benefit measured
Only this capture bottleneck fixed; other customer pain points remain open
